Prepare Form 1 for the incorporation application after name approval. The recorded Form 1 base charge is LKR 4000, excluding VAT and other charges; payment is outside this preparation step.
Prepare Form 18 director consent documentation for the application.
Prepare Form 19 secretary consent documentation for the application.
Prepare two copies of the Articles of Association for the manual application.

After preparing the four document sets, submit them with the approved name certificate for the format check. All four sets are required. No order or independence between their preparation steps is asserted. This snapshot stops before payment, incorporation and later obligations.
